title: One op at a time
prompt: add is done. Fill in mul (multiply) and max (the larger of the two). Both lines return 0 right now.
hints: Copy the shape of the `add` line. Only the math changes.
Python has a built-in `max(a, b)`. Or write `a if a > b else b`.
explain: Each op is one branch that turns two numbers into one: `a * b` for `mul` and `max(a, b)` for `max`. An interpreter is mostly a list of branches like these, one per op the language has.
